# [In preview] Public Preview: PostgreSQL skills and MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL

## What Changed

The PostgreSQL skills and MCP plugin turns supported AI coding assistants into context-aware PostgreSQL experts that can both provide guidance and act on a connected database. The bundled plugin combines expert-curated skills for PostgreSQL and Azure Data
